laws.rule: Faro city charges a municipal tourist tax of EUR 2 per guest per night (about A$3.18, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) from 1 March to 31 October and EUR 1 from November to February, for guests aged 16 and over, up to 7 consecutive nights.
laws.heading: Município de Faro, Regulamento 1207/2024

laws.rule: The municipality of Albufeira (Algarve) has a Code of Conduct banning inappropriate behaviour in public places. Smartraveller says on-the-spot fines range from EUR 150 to EUR 1,800 (about A$238 to A$2,860; RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293).
laws.heading: Smartraveller travel advice
laws.penalty_signal: on-the-spot fine of EUR 150 to EUR 1,800

sources.authority: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Smartraveller)
